description: This file defines the PHP class PartialJobSpecificationAttachment within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin, specifically in the Dto (Data Transfer Object) namespace. The class encapsulates properties related to attachments for job specifications, including id, filename, file type, size, and associated job title ID. It provides a constructor and getter methods for these properties.

classes.name: PartialJobSpecificationAttachment
classes.description: A data transfer object representing an attachment related to a job specification, including attributes such as id, filename, type, size, and associated job title id.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class with provided id, filename, type, size, and job title id.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment file.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the associated job title ID.
